summary: Tested 6 new admin features for Adverlyx Digital SaaS platform: Subscription Renewals, Refund Management, Invoices, i18n (Multi-language), Admin Charts, and Affiliate Dashboard. All backend APIs are working correctly. Frontend pages are properly integrated.

ui_bugs.issue: Referral link shows '?ref=undefined' when user is not logged in
ui_bugs.note: This is expected behavior - user needs to be logged in to see their referral code

critical_code_review_comments: Traffic data (page views, visitors, bounce rate) is MOCKED/SIMULATED for demo purposes - real data would come from Google Analytics integration
All admin endpoints properly enforce admin-only access with 403 responses for non-admin users
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 new admin features are working: Subscription Renewals (settings, upcoming, due, history), Refund Management (list, stats, approve/reject/process), Invoices (user invoices, admin all invoices, PDF generation), i18n (14 languages supported, translations editor), Admin Charts (revenue, users, traffic, conversion funnel, realtime stats), Affiliate Dashboard (referral program, affiliate program).

subscription_renewals.frontend_page: /admin/renewals - Shows Due Now (0), Upcoming (7), Auto-Renewal ON, Grace Period 7 days

endpoints_tested: GET /api/refunds/ - Returns refunds list with stats (0 pending, 0 processed)
refund_management.frontend_page: /admin/refunds - Shows Pending (0), Processed (0), Total Refunded ($0.00), Refund Rate (0%)

endpoints_tested: GET /api/invoices/my-invoices - Returns user's invoices (empty for demo user)
GET /api/invoices/admin/all - Returns 18 invoices with customer details
GET /api/i18n/languages - Returns 14 supported languages (en, es, fr, de, pt, it, nl, ru, ja, ko, zh, ar, hi, tr)
GET /api/i18n/translations/es - Returns Spanish translations with 60+ keys
i18n_multilanguage.frontend_page: /admin/languages - Language Settings panel with enabled languages, Translations Editor with search

endpoints_tested: GET /api/admin/charts/users?days=30 - Returns 27 total users, +19 this period
GET /api/admin/charts/traffic?days=30 - Returns 5,720 page views, 33.4% bounce rate
GET /api/admin/charts/traffic-sources - Returns 5 sources (organic 42%, direct 25%, social 18%, referral 10%, paid 5%)
GET /api/admin/charts/conversion-funnel - Returns funnel stages (Visitors → Sign Ups → Trials → Paid)
GET /api/admin/charts/dashboard-summary - Returns comprehensive summary with charts
admin_charts.frontend_page: /admin/charts - Real-time Stats, Revenue Trend, User Growth, Website Traffic, Traffic Sources, Conversion Funnel

endpoints_tested: GET /api/programs/referral/info - Returns referral_code, referral_link, total_referrals, rewards
affiliate_dashboard.frontend_page: /affiliate/dashboard - Partner Program with Overview, Referral Program tabs, stats cards

Top pages data - SIMULATED page view counts
